addr: No. L, 367, 5th Main Rd, Sector 6, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: This is hands down the worst parking experience I've ever had. The area is so poorly maintained it looks more like a dumping ground than a parking lot. What’s most frustrating is the total ignorance from management; they seem completely indifferent to the state of the facility and have clearly given up on basic upkeep
Pretty cool and clean space. We had an event hosted on the terrace. It gets too cold after 10 pm. I definitely recommend this space for events.
